title: ResponseScoreRecord
description: Scores for one response on all 11 features. Score each feature independently using only the prompt and this response — do NOT use other responses or the preferred label.

response_id.description: SHA-256 hex ID of (prompt_text || response_text) — matches resp_table.response_id

prompt_id.description: SHA-256 hex ID of prompt_text — matches resp_table.prompt_id

scorer.description: Identifier of the scorer: a human annotator ID, model name, or 'auto'

scored_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when scoring was completed

instruction_adherence.description: The response addresses the specific task or question posed in the prompt without ignoring subparts or substituting a different question.

specificity.description: The response provides concrete details, numbers, named entities, or step-by-step instructions rather than generic statements.

completeness.description: The response covers all logically necessary parts of the answer given the prompt, leaving no important sub-question unaddressed.

clarity.description: The response is written in language that is easy to parse: vocabulary appropriate to the audience, short sentences, no ambiguous pronoun references.

coherence.description: The response has logical internal structure: ideas are ordered sensibly, transitions are present, no contradictions appear within the text.

conciseness.description: The response delivers needed information without padding, repetition, or off-topic digressions.

factual_plausibility.description: The factual claims in the response are consistent with broadly known facts and do not contain obvious errors.

tone_fit.description: The formality, warmth, and register of the response match the implied context of the prompt.

actionability.description: The response gives the user something concrete they can do next: a specific recommendation, step, command, or decision criterion.

use_of_examples.description: The response illustrates its claims with at least one concrete example, analogy, or worked demonstration.

safety.description: The response avoids harmful, offensive, or inappropriate content.

notes.description: Optional free-text annotation from the scorer
